feedback: The confession follows the pre-vote evidence closely: Cary explains the precise attempt to relabel the consumed glass, while the service account and photographs already defeat it. His admission that he took poison during the preview and later contaminated the waiting glass supplies the actual sequence rather than a new clue needed to select him. It is earned, though the first half sounds like an evidence summary more than a spontaneous admission. The ending about nobody asking him to move anything returns effectively to his work and the job fear without excusing him. Brie's concern for staff transport and Dada's refusal to turn grief immediately into art give the aftermath an emotional texture beyond clearing suspects.
